frames: each STL is one unit as delivered: millimetres, resting on its most likely stable face on z = 0, its footprint's smallest enclosing rectangle centred on the origin with its long side along x; a unit's printed parts, its actuator module and its output pulley are in one file; com_mm = the unit's centre of mass in its STL's frame (from the CAD)
material: printed parts: PA12, natural off-white (undyed), all one colour; actuator modules: dark housings with an aluminium output pulley

units.role: the body with its four hip ab/ad actuator modules and their output pulleys (bolted on the stand in the cell)
shoulder module: the hip flexion actuator in its shell with its output pulley; its key mounts on a hip ab/ad output pulley
shoulder module with the hip adapter: the hip flexion actuator in its shell with its output pulley; its key mounts on a hip ab/ad output pulley
hip ab/ad support: the bracket that closes over a shoulder module's journal and bolts onto the body
upper leg with the knee actuator and its output pulley; its key mounts on a shoulder's hip flexion output pulley
lower leg with its foot; its key mounts on an upper leg's knee output pulley

actuator.note: every hip ab/ad, hip flexion and knee joint is one of these modules; a unit's key fits its output pulley's socket in two orientations 180 deg apart

identical_units: units with the same id are interchangeable
